args.prompt:
Make a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, Small Domestic Hauntings. The original inputs are style references for rounded footless whole dark charcoal-plum organic splat bodies, tiny ink hands, thick filled modeled eyelids, cream white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Exactly six independent complete upright figures in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 real transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. Keep each silhouette, drops and all held props within its own cell, generous clear alpha gutters and margins. No stage, floor, shadows, scenery, border, branding or labels. Large sparse hand-shaped marks, gentle smooth satin clay, broad fabric folds, clear glass and clean finished plastic. Avoid dense grit and stipple. Tiny costume accents, dominant ink body and distinct readable expressions. Teeth behind lips. Do not inherit reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Palette: Dusty sage, warm linen, ivory and subtle cool blue household accents. Row-major cast:
1. Male-read radiator ghost. squat wide ink blob, annoyed sidelong eyes and tight pout. Key cue: small brass radiator bleed key and one miniature old radiator rib held against the side.
2. Female-read bedsheet ghost. tall rippling ink blob, sheepish smile and lowered brows. Key cue: one short ivory bedsheet draped over a head lobe like a cap, two oversized clothespins on the hem, dark whole face and body visible.
3. Male-read night fright. low pear with one curved head lobe, round startled eyes and open O mouth. Key cue: tiny plug-shaped bedside nightlight with a warm clear amber lens.
4. Female-read cupboard poltergeist. broad asymmetrical body, sly side eye and cheerful crooked grin. Key cue: one small porcelain cup and two plain saucers balanced tightly in both hands.
5. Male-read laundry ghost. lean crooked upright curl, weary lids and closed small frown. Key cue: single striped sock worn as a floppy cap, a tiny laundry peg held at belly.
6. Male-read creaking-floor spirit. low squashed square ink blob, searching eyes and a small startled grimace. Key cue: one palm-sized warped plank with one round blunt nail head.
Six distinct standalone cutouts and strongly differentiated body shapes.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
